title: Prevent Workflow V1 history-cap state corruption
businessObjective: Keep the bounded Workflow V1 runtime durable and self-consistent during prolonged provider or quota outages.
technicalObjective: Prevent any normal transition from persisting more than the 64-entry history contract or producing a record that its own validator rejects; preserve deterministic fail-closed behavior at the history boundary without adding infrastructure or production authority.
assumptions: The merged P3-003 implementation remains Tier-0/shadow and non-authoritative; no production write, deployment, credential access, provider integration, or external state is authorized.
The existing 64-entry history and revision invariant remains the contract; this remediation adds bounded behavior at the limit rather than weakening the validator or silently deleting audit history.
The original verified P3-003 packet and all historical evidence remain immutable records and are not edited by this remediation.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated provider_wait or quota_wait transitions at the 64-entry history boundary never append a 65th entry, never persist an invalid record, and return a deterministic fail-closed WORKFLOW_HISTORY_LIMIT_REACHED decision.
Every normal transition path either persists a record satisfying the existing history-length and revision invariants or returns a deterministic fail-closed decision without mutating durable state.
Records with 63 entries can make one valid transition to 64 entries, while records already at 64 entries remain loadable and cannot self-corrupt under continued provider or quota unavailability.
Focused regression tests cover provider and quota outage repetition, the 63/64 boundary, persisted round trips, malformed and hostile values, and preservation of ordinary pre-boundary transitions.

No provider SDK, database, queue, scheduler, network, credential, deployment, production write, booking, payment, inventory, pricing, finalized-platform, or architecture-source behavior is introduced.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-P3-003-R01 --base origin/main --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
requiredChecks: history-cap boundary and outage regression validation
solEscalationTriggers: Any change crosses the declared workflow-runtime, test, documentation, evidence, or remediation-packet paths.
Any request for infrastructure, provider, persistence, queue, scheduler, transaction, outbox, credential, deployment, booking, payment, pricing, inventory, authorization, RLS, or production behavior.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the remediation branch and generated artifacts while preserving the merged P3-003 packet, historical evidence, and any blocked verification records.
